quote: A vehicle shall not be permitted to stand unattended upon any perceptible grade without stopping the engine and effectively setting the brake thereon and turning the front wheels to the curb or side of the highway.

activation.condition: A motor vehicle stands unattended upon a perceptible highway grade

obligation.description: Permit unattended graded standing without stopping the engine, effectively setting the brake, and turning front wheels toward the curb or highway side
obligation.source_clause: shall not be permitted to stand unattended upon any perceptible grade without stopping the engine and effectively setting the brake thereon and turning the front wheels to the curb or side of the highway

timing.description: Engine and brake are checked over the unattended stand; wheel direction is required before departure and throughout that stand

judgment_calls_needed.note: Original cabin occupancy and identified responsible-person absence require review.
The authored 4 percent grade is an engineering request; perceptibility is a judgment, not a numeric legal cutoff.
Original brake command/readback and absence of movement require physical review.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: turning the front wheels to the curb or side of the highway
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original calibrated wheel orientation and right-curb survey require review.

parameter_refs.name: parking_brake
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: original same-frame parking-brake readback and effective holding review

parameter_refs.name: front_wheel_orientation
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: calibrated original wheel orientation relative to surveyed curb
